cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've sent a thumbs-up like yours. Now tell me you understand why six weeks without an answer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine meant I'd received your message. My phone was broken; I wasn't saying the silence didn't matter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, received. I didn't get a repair notice, though. What did those six weeks look like from my end?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You thought I'd stopped caring. I can see why you'd stop writing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I didn't stop. I kept rewriting the same message to make it easier to answer. Can you understand what that did to me?

reason: Copy message receipt as emotional closure while B partial acknowledgment prompts correction of the actual emotional cost.
